verdict.rationale: Extensive docs confirm skills are plain folders with a required SKILL.md (YAML frontmatter + Markdown) plus optional scripts/references/assets, explicitly published as the open Agent Skills standard for cross-platform portability, and GitHub examples show copying/uploading these plain files across surfaces (Claude Code, API, Claude.ai). Community evidence corroborates they are literally '.md files' developers read and manage. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on report of someone physically carrying a SKILL.md folder into a non-Anthropic harness (e.g., a third-party agent) to confirm true cross-harness portability in practice.
